args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (from #inc-qfl-sev1, 4 Nov 2025; times as logged in the channel, time zone not stated)

• What broke: the dock schedule sync at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Superior terminal stalled. Dana reported it at 07:02, with the issue starting around 06:40 local. Drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
• Who found the cause: Samir Patel (on-call). He identified a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant at 07:17. He had started by checking the 06:30 UTC deployment.
• Mitigation: Samir cleared the stuck jobs. The terminal got a partial sync around 08:15, but a few inbound trailers were still duplicating.
• Resolved: Samir deployed a hotfix and finished the replay script at 14:38, and all Superior dock schedules synced cleanly in real time. Dana declared it resolved at 14:44 after Thea confirmed.

Gaps: the channel has no postmortem notes. The root-cause detail beyond the webhook listener and the exact start time are unconfirmed. Dana, please check before this goes to the exec call.
